mutations.name: select-instead-of-add
mutations.what: the folder of a session is SELECTED in the Hub, which switches the workspace of the desktop app

mutations.name: task-without-workspace
mutations.what: a task is started without the folder of the session (it would run in the one the Hub has selected)

mutations.name: later-prompt-starts
mutations.what: a later prompt of a session starts a new task instead of continuing the conversation

patches.old: const task = session.taskId === null ? await hub.startTask({ prompt: text, workspacePath: session.workspacePath }) : await hub.continueTask({ id: session.taskId, prompt: text });
patches.new: const task = await hub.startTask({ prompt: text, workspacePath: session.workspacePath });

mutations.name: embedded-protected-check-off
mutations.what: the text of a protected file that the editor embeds is sent to the model

patches.old: const protectedName = isProtectedPath(place.file ? (place.inside ? place.relative : paths.basename(place.absolute)) : nameOfUri(resource.uri));

mutations.name: csrf-token-wrong
mutations.what: a POST carries a CSRF token that is not the Hub's

mutations.name: hub-lets-go-ignored
mutations.what: a task at rest ends the turn although the Hub may still hold the workspace
mutations.equivalent: the Hub lets go of the workspace within a moment of turning the task "completed", so a turn that ends at once and one that waits for the release are not told apart by a run of the suite; the scripted Hub of verify-acp-logic.mjs holds the workspace on purpose and kills this mutation there (active-ignored)
